title: Planet and sun
description: The two bodies of every system. The feature document, planet_and_sun.md, is the primary record.

entities.name: A planet ahead, a sun behind
entities.description: Every arrival places the system's planet ahead of the pilot and its sun behind.
entities.behavior: On arrival the planet and the sun are placed from the system's own positions, the planet's by the legal status's low bit.
entities.outcome: Each system has its own geography to fly through.

entities.name: Altitude and crashing
entities.description: Flying too low crashes into the planet.
entities.behavior: Outside the Deep, on the tick whose 32-tick phase is 10, the low-energy warning shows when energy is below 50 and the altitude is worked out from the planet's distance; inside the planet, or at altitude 0, the player dies and the tick ends.
entities.outcome: The planet is a hazard as well as a destination.
constraints: ALTITUDE_PHASE is 10 of every 32 ticks, so a crash is found up to 32 ticks late.

entities.name: The sun's heat and fuel scooping
entities.description: Close to the sun the cabin heats up; skimming it with a fuel scoop fills the tank.
entities.behavior: Outside the Deep, on the tick whose 32-tick phase is 20, the cabin temperature is worked out from the sun's distance; a temperature that would pass 255 burns the player up. With a fuel scoop, no station present and a temperature of at least 224, fuel is scooped and the scooping message shows.
entities.outcome: Fuel for free, at a risk.
constraints: SUN_PHASE is 20 of every 32 ticks; SCOOP_HEAT is 224.
No gradual heat damage (RULES B open question 4).

relatedViews.relationship: The pilot's goals that exercise it.
The system's planet and sun positions.
